structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Not for a while. I really gotta go."

structure.script_literal: "ChFrEx.He’s working."

structure.raw_value: CaFlOp.Always a hard worker… Good luck with that, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlOp.Always a hard worker… Good luck with that, 1Hero."

structure.script_literal: "ChFrOp.Thanks for walking with me, 1Hero."

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Working on the tractor?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Working on the tractor?"

structure.raw_value: CaAnEx.The damn thing won't start and it’s a pain in the ass to get around it.
structure.script_literal: "CaAnEx.The damn thing won't start and it’s a pain in the ass to get around it."

structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Going to be a late night?"

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.At least the weather seems good… for now.

structure.raw_value: CaFrOp.Besides, it’s good to give the girls some privacy.

structure.script_literal: "CaFlDe.Aww, too bad. Would be nice to spend some time with a real man."

structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.More teasing?"

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Hopefully nothing too bad.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Hopefully nothing too bad."

structure.script_literal: "CaBaEx.Here we are, a Sunday night and the girls are having a sleepover."

structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.No school tomorrow."

structure.raw_value: CaSaEx.They need to grow up.
structure.script_literal: "CaSaEx.They need to grow up."

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I know. Just give them time.

structure.raw_value: CaSaDe.I’m running out of patience, but I admit it’s better than being lonely in the house.

structure.script_literal: "CaFlOp.Looking to hang out with the old ladies?"

structure.raw_value: CaFrOp.Related to your case?
structure.script_literal: "CaFrOp.Related to your case?"

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Possibly… There are thieves running around the forest… Can’t be too safe.

structure.raw_value: CaFlOp.Care for some company?
structure.script_literal: "CaFlOp.Care for some company?"

structure.raw_value: McShCl.Carol!

structure.script_literal: "HeFrOp.Enjoying the cool morning weather?"

structure.raw_value: HeFrEx.1Hero knows what he’s doing. He’ll make the right choices.

structure.raw_value: McWoClNo1.Carol!
structure.script_literal: "McWoClNo1.Carol!"

structure.script_literal: "HnAnDeNo1.Hmf!"

translation: Phi!

source_text: She went back to the church with Papa Brian.

structure.raw_value: HnFrEx.She went back to the church with Papa Brian.
structure.script_literal: "HnFrEx.She went back to the church with Papa Brian."

translation: Wróciła do kościoła z ojcem Brianem.

source_text: I didn’t see her there.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.I didn’t see her there.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.I didn’t see her there."

translation: Nie widziałem jej tam.

source_text: Oh, no! Drakan got her!

structure.raw_value: HnShClNo1.Oh, no! Drakan got her!
structure.script_literal: "HnShClNo1.Oh, no! Drakan got her!"

translation: O nie! Drakan ją dopadł!

source_text: Hannah! Don’t be so negative!

structure.raw_value: CaAnOpNo1.Hannah! Don’t be so negative!
structure.script_literal: "CaAnOpNo1.Hannah! Don’t be so negative!"

translation: Hannah! Nie bądź taką pesymistką!

source_text: Duncan’s not looking for Judy, he was looking for an amulet…

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Duncan’s not looking for Judy, he was looking for an amulet…
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Duncan’s not looking for Judy, he was looking for an amulet…"

translation: Duncan nie szukał Judy, tylko amuletu…

source_text: I’m sure she’s fine. I’ll find her.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I’m sure she’s fine. I’ll find her.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I’m sure she’s fine. I’ll find her."

translation: Na pewno nic jej nie jest. Znajdę ją.

source_text: Are you going to arrest them?

structure.raw_value: CaBaDe.Are you going to arrest them?
structure.script_literal: "CaBaDe.Are you going to arrest them?"

translation: Zamierzasz ich aresztować?

source_text: Yes. It’s just about over.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Yes. It’s just about over.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Yes. It’s just about over."

translation: Tak. To już prawie koniec.

source_text: Get’em, 1Hero!

structure.raw_value: HnFrEx.Get’em, 1Hero!
structure.script_literal: "HnFrEx.Get’em, 1Hero!"

translation: Dorwać ich, 1Hero!

source_text: Hannah! You’re terrifying the little fella!

structure.raw_value: CaWoAgNo1.Hannah! You’re terrifying the little fella!
structure.script_literal: "CaWoAgNo1.Hannah! You’re terrifying the little fella!"

translation: Hannah! Przerażasz tego biedaka!

source_text: I’m gonna catch him! Just you watch!

structure.raw_value: HnHaAg.I’m gonna catch him! Just you watch!
structure.script_literal: "HnHaAg.I’m gonna catch him! Just you watch!"

translation: Złapię go! Zobaczysz!

source_text: The goat’s back?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.The goat’s back?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.The goat’s back?"

translation: Kozioł wrócił?

source_text: Looks like he survived.

structure.raw_value: HeFrEx.Looks like he survived.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrEx.Looks like he survived."

translation: Wygląda na to, że przeżył.

source_text: Hey! It’s 1Hero and Heather!

structure.raw_value: HnHaOp.Hey! It’s 1Hero and Heather!
structure.script_literal: "HnHaOp.Hey! It’s 1Hero and Heather!"

translation: Hej! To 1Hero i Heather!

source_text: I’m stopping by to help your mom cook some dinner.

structure.raw_value: HeHaEx^.I’m stopping by to help your mom cook some dinner.
structure.script_literal: "HeHaEx^.I’m stopping by to help your mom cook some dinner."

translation: Wpadłam pomóc twojej mamie przygotować kolację.

source_text: Oh boy! What are we having?

structure.raw_value: HnHaAg.Oh boy! What are we having?
structure.script_literal: "HnHaAg.Oh boy! What are we having?"

translation: O rany! Co będzie na kolację?

source_text: Well, if you’re up for it, we’re having a party with Chloe and Judy.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.Well, if you’re up for it, we’re having a party with Chloe and Judy.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.Well, if you’re up for it, we’re having a party with Chloe and Judy."

translation: Jeśli masz ochotę, urządzamy dziś przyjęcie z Chloe i Judy.

source_text: You’re having a party?

structure.raw_value: HnShOp.You’re having a party?
structure.script_literal: "HnShOp.You’re having a party?"

translation: Urządzacie przyjęcie?

source_text: The girls are going to watch 1Hero on the news. You should join them, Hannah.

structure.raw_value: HeHaEx^.The girls are going to watch 1Hero on the news. You should join them, Hannah.
structure.script_literal: "HeHaEx^.The girls are going to watch 1Hero on the news. You should join them, Hannah."

translation: Dziewczyny będą oglądać 1Hero w wiadomościach. Dołącz do nich, Hannah.

source_text: Sounds like a lot of fun. I guess us old ladies aren’t invited.

structure.raw_value: CaFlDe.Sounds like a lot of fun. I guess us old ladies aren’t invited.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlDe.Sounds like a lot of fun. I guess us old ladies aren’t invited."

translation: Brzmi świetnie. Chyba nas, starszych pań, nie zaproszono.

source_text: Oh, Carol. Let’s sit this one out.

structure.raw_value: HeFlEx^.Oh, Carol. Let’s sit this one out.
structure.script_literal: "HeFlEx^.Oh, Carol. Let’s sit this one out."

translation: Och, Carol. Tym razem odpuśćmy.

source_text: But what’s for supper?

structure.raw_value: HnBaDe.But what’s for supper?
structure.script_literal: "HnBaDe.But what’s for supper?"

translation: Ale co będzie na kolację?

source_text: Chloe and Judy are going to cook chicken stir-fry.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Chloe and Judy are going to cook chicken stir-fry.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Chloe and Judy are going to cook chicken stir-fry."

translation: Chloe i Judy zrobią kurczaka z warzywami z patelni.

source_text: I’m heading over!

structure.raw_value: HnHaAg.I’m heading over!
structure.script_literal: "HnHaAg.I’m heading over!"

translation: Już idę!

source_text: Be back for bedtime, ya hear?

structure.raw_value: CaBaEx.Be back for bedtime, ya hear?
structure.script_literal: "CaBaEx.Be back for bedtime, ya hear?"

translation: Wróć przed porą spania, jasne?

source_text: Yes, Ma!

structure.raw_value: HnHaAg.Yes, Ma!
structure.script_literal: "HnHaAg.Yes, Ma!"

translation: Tak jest, mamo!

source_text: Looks like that little goat is pretty fast.

structure.raw_value: McFlDe.Looks like that little goat is pretty fast.
structure.script_literal: "McFlDe.Looks like that little goat is pretty fast."

translation: Ten mały kozioł jest całkiem szybki.

source_text: We almost had it.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.We almost had it.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.We almost had it."

translation: Prawie go złapaliśmy.

source_text: It’s nice weather out. Maybe we have some time before dinner to search for it.

structure.raw_value: HeFrOp^.It’s nice weather out. Maybe we have some time before dinner to search for it.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrOp^.It’s nice weather out. Maybe we have some time before dinner to search for it."

translation: Ładna dziś pogoda. Może zdążymy go poszukać przed kolacją.

source_text: I don’t know. I’m getting pretty hungry.

structure.raw_value: CaBaDe.I don’t know. I’m getting pretty hungry.
structure.script_literal: "CaBaDe.I don’t know. I’m getting pretty hungry."

translation: Nie wiem. Robię się już głodna.

source_text: It’s early. I can help you if you want.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.It’s early. I can help you if you want.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.It’s early. I can help you if you want."

translation: Jest jeszcze wcześnie. Mogę ci pomóc, jeśli chcesz.

source_text: Alright. Let’s see if we can’t get a hold of that little goat.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.Alright. Let’s see if we can’t get a hold of that little goat.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.Alright. Let’s see if we can’t get a hold of that little goat."

translation: Dobra. Zobaczmy, czy uda nam się złapać tego koziołka.
